digest.component_or_area: LLM provider inference and model resolution
propositions: infer_provider maps 'gemini' prefix to provider name 'google_genai' which is unknown to both pydantic-ai registry and rebar's ProviderSession
bare gemini-* model ids fail at call time with LLMConfigError when composed through model_classes._resolve_target path, despite appearing valid at config time
mapping gemini to 'google' (pydantic-ai's canonical Gemini Developer API provider) resolves both infer_provider and ProviderSession.is_resolvable checks
google-gla and google-vertex alternatives are deprecated and removed in pydantic-ai v2.0, making google the stable choice
all values in _PROVIDER_PREFIXES must resolve to providers known by both _pydantic_ai_known_providers or ProviderSession._builders to prevent future regressions
